timeline.labelEn: Frank Gehry, Canadian-American architect of the Guggenheim Bilbao and the Dancing House
timeline.labelDe: Frank Gehry, kanadisch-amerikanischer Architekt des Guggenheim-Museums Bilbao und des Tanzenden Hauses

source.title: Frank Gehry’s “Experience Music Project” Building (Seattle, WA) v. the “Fondation Louis Vuitton” in Paris, France

questions.notes: Seattle's Experience Music Project (smashed guitar), Prague's Dancing House ('Ginger and Fred', with Vlado Milunić) and the Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris (glass 'sails'). Gehry was born in Toronto and held Canadian and US citizenship.

questions.de: Der Film Alien – Das unheimliche Wesen aus einer fremden Welt von 1979 hatte welchen furchteinflößenden, aber astronomisch korrekten Werbeslogan?
questions.en: The 1979 film Alien had which frightening but astronomically correct tagline?
questions.answerEn: "In space no one can hear you scream."

timeline.labelEn: US release of Ridley Scott's film Alien
timeline.labelDe: US-Kinostart von Ridley Scotts Film Alien

questions.notes: Correct because sound needs a medium and cannot travel through the vacuum of space.

questions.en: Which parts of the road must Segways and other small electric vehicles use in Germany where they exist?

timeline.labelEn: Germany's Electric Small Vehicles Ordinance (eKFV) comes into force
timeline.labelDe: Die deutsche Elektrokleinstfahrzeuge-Verordnung (eKFV) tritt in Kraft

questions.notes: Card's true/false statement (pavements off-limits to Segways) is true; reworked to an open question. Under the eKFV (not the StVO itself) they must use cycle paths/lanes, else the carriageway; pavements only with the sign 'Elektrokleinstfahrzeuge frei'.
